_about: Registry of HyperFrames templates used by the youtube-edit skill. Every template takes the active theme (motion/themes, chosen by brand.json/plan.json "style"), so these describe content, not looks. 'fullscreen' graphics cover the whole frame; 'hide_captions' also hides captions under them; 'zone' tells captions.py where an overlay sits so captions can move out of its way. Brand/theme colors are injected automatically; 'props' are the per-use variables.

lower-third.use: Introduce yourself, a guest or a product the first time they appear. Once or twice per video.

callout.use: Reinforce a key term, number or tip the moment it's spoken. Keep text under ~5 words.

highlight.use: Point at something on screen as it's mentioned or clicked: a button, a field, a price. Draws a box/circle/underline; dim=true spotlights it.

props.x: left edge in the FINAL 1920x1080 frame (read it off a `snapshots --from base` frame)
props.label: optional short label next to it

steps.use: Show where we are in a multi-step process (checkout, setup, a tutorial's parts). Re-use with a higher 'current' as the video moves on.

props.steps: "Cart, Checkout, Transfer, Done" (or a JSON array)
props.current: 0-based index of the step happening now

kinetic.use: A hook or punchline in big words that pop in one by one. 2-6 words.

props.emphasis: comma-separated words to color with the accent
props.backdrop: true (themed background, default) or false (words over the video)

title-card.use: Chapter / section openers and the hook title. Voice keeps playing underneath.

tool-cards.use: Overview of a stack, steps or options (2-8 items). Use highlight to point at the one being discussed.

props.heading: optional
props.items: JSON string: [{"role":"The editor","name":"Claude Code","icon":"optional image path"}]
props.highlight: -1 to step through all, or the 0-based index to spotlight

browser-frame.use: Show a website/screenshot captured in the research step. Tall pages scroll slowly.

end-card.use: The closing call to action: subscribe, visit the site, book a call.
